DECLARE @Report_Month_CCYYMM CHAR(6)
SET @Report_Month_CCYYMM = @Report_Month_CCYYMM

SELECT 
CASE WHEN LEN(@Report_Month_CCYYMM) = 6 AND ISNUMERIC(@Report_Month_CCYYMM) = 1 THEN @Report_Month_CCYYMM ELSE CONVERT(CHAR(6), DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE())-1, 0), 112) END AS Report_Month_CCYYMM
,CONVERT(CHAR(8),GETDATE(),112) AS [Creation_Date]
,CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8),GETDATE(),108),':','') AS CHAR(6)) AS [Creation_Time]
